metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1980 · The Shining
metas.description: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter, where a sinister presence influences the father into violence. At the same time, his psychic son sees horrifying forebodings from both the past and the future.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1986 · Aliens
metas.description: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the Alien Queen and her offspring.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1982 · The Thing
metas.description: A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1987 · Predator
metas.description: A team of commandos on a mission in a Central American jungle find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1986 · The Fly
metas.description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1987 · Evil Dead II
metas.description: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1981 · An American Werewolf in London
metas.description: American college students David Kessler and Jack Goodman on a walking tour of Britain are attacked by a werewolf that none of the locals will admit exists. Jack dies. David recovers in a hospital, where he has nightmares.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1984 · A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1989 · Santa Sangre
metas.description: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless mother - the leader of a strange religious cult - and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name as he becomes "her arms".

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1984 · Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1983 · The Evil Dead
metas.description: Five friends travel to a cabin in the woods, where they unknowingly release flesh-possessing demons.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1982 · Poltergeist
metas.description: A family's home becomes the center of paranormal activity that opens a doorway to the "other side." With help, they must cross over to get their daughter back.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1985 · The Return of the Living Dead
metas.description: When two bumbling employees at a medical supply warehouse accidentally release a deadly gas into the air, the vapors cause the dead to rise again as zombies.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1987 · The Lost Boys
metas.description: When a recently divorced mother and her two teenage boys move to a coastal town to stay with her father, it doesn't take long for the brothers to realize the area is a haven for something much more sinister than party-going surfers.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1988 · They Live
metas.description: They influence our decisions without us knowing it. They numb our senses without us feeling it. They control our lives without us realizing it. They live.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1987 · Angel Heart
metas.description: In 1955 New Orleans, small-time private investigator Harry Angel is hired by a man who calls himself Louis Cypher to track down a singer named Johnny Favorite, but the investigation takes an unexpected and somber turn.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1983 · Possession
metas.description: A woman starts exhibiting increasingly disturbing behavior after asking her husband for a divorce. Suspicions of infidelity soon give way to something much more sinister.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1988 · Dead Ringers
metas.description: Twin gynecologists take full advantage of the fact that nobody can tell them apart, until their relationship begins to deteriorate over a woman.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1983 · Videodrome
metas.description: A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1986 · Little Shop of Horrors
metas.description: A nerdy florist finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant who demands to be fed.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1985 · Fright Night
metas.description: "Fright Night" sees a teenager believing that the newcomer in his neighborhood is a vampire. He turns to an actor in a television hosted horror movie show for help to deal with the undead.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1985 · Day of the Dead
metas.description: As the world is overrun by zombies, a group of scientists and military personnel sheltering in an underground bunker in Florida must decide on how they should deal with the undead horde.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1985 · Re-Animator
metas.description: After an odd new medical student arrives on campus, a dedicated local and his girlfriend become involved in bizarre experiments centering around the re-animation of dead tissue.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1980 · The Changeling
metas.description: After experiencing tragic personal losses, a music professor rents a Seattle mansion, haunted by a slain boy.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1982 · Tenebrae
metas.description: An American novelist visiting Rome to promote his latest book is stalked and harassed by an obsessed fan who is committing a string of murders that appear to be tributes to his work.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1987 · The Hidden
metas.description: A cop and an FBI agent race for answers after law abiding people suddenly become violent criminals.
